verdict.rationale: Finix docs show onboarding forms and APIs for onboarding sellers, plus dashboard/API controls for seller payouts, implying some flexibility in what's collected before payout, but there's no explicit documentation of a tunable 'minimum to start selling then collect more before payout thresholds' workflow or explicit per-seller requirements-due states. missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable onboarding requirement tiers, requirements-due state tracking per seller, and evidence of payout-threshold gating tied to progressive data collection.
